open_questions: Duplicate definitions: z_stream_s, ct_data, static_tree_desc, tree_desc and deflate_state_s duplicate chunk_036_types.h (deflate_state_s here names l_buf and lit_bufsize that 036 leaves as padding); field_s duplicates chunk_038_types.h. The merge lane must keep one definition each before compiling chunks 036/037/038 together.

Placeholders are now merged names (inflateEnd, inflateInit2_, inflateInit_, inflate, init_block, build_tree, scan_tree, send_tree); the merge lane should confirm chunk_036 keeps these signatures. g_08606888 (tty hide depth) and the stub bodies at 0x080d3740..0x080d3764 have no merged name or caller evidence.
Total size of deflate_state_s is not asserted: the binary allocates it in deflateInit2 (outside this chunk), so only offsets are checked. Confirm the size from that allocation.

Rodata tables (g_0815108c, g_081510a0, g_08151520, g_0815159f, g_081516a0, g_08150f40, g_081518a0, g_08150fc0, g_08151920) are declared extern; their contents were not dumped and are assumed to match zlib 1.1.4 trees.c. Verify with objdump -s on .rodata before relying on the distance-code offset.
The stub and tty helpers (Tty_StubReturnZero, Tty_StubReturnOne, Tty_StubReturnZeroAlt, Tty_StubNoopA, Tty_StubNoopB) are named only by shape; the platform hook they stand in for is unknown.

Dead or faithful-but-odd behaviour is kept on purpose: unzReadLocalExtraField reads the full remaining length, zlib_uncompress keeps ILP32 equality checks, and Tty_DrainStdin never ends on EOF. Confirm whether the owner wants these preserved.
